templates.name: Hand Hygiene Steps
templates.description: The five-step handwashing routine for sinks and corridors.

elements.text: Warm water first, then soap both hands.
Rub palm to palm, then over each hand.
Interlace the fingers, twist each thumb.
Scrub fingertips in each palm, then wrists.
Rinse well and dry with a clean towel.

Your records stay confidential at all times.
